title: Very soft!
text: Very soft!. I love it!  I just wish it was easier to wrestle it on to the body pillow! Maybe Velcro closures or ??? would work - but I'll continue to do whatever it takes, because I just can't get to sleep on a chilly winter night without my cozy warm body pillow to lean against!

product_metadata.title: Reafort Ultra Soft Sherpa Pillowcases Pillow Covers Standard Size 20"x26" Pack of 2 with Zipper Closure (Silver Grey, 20”x26” Standard Sham)
features: 100% polyester thick sherpa material. Adding soft and warm feel to your Stand Sham.
Size: Set of 2 20"x26" standard sham with zipper closure. Easy to put on and take off.
Various color options allow you mix and match freely.
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Do not bleach.
This is a cover only, does NOT contain a pillow.
